name: kit
description: Wyatt's Claude Code kit, and only what he actually uses. The MENTOR coaches how he framed each request before the work runs, then grades the ask — framing, leverage, learnings applied. The CRITIC judges, in fresh context and its own words, whether the thing he ASKED for actually happened, then grades the delivery — did it happen, was there evidence, did it stay in scope. Both write to one append-only ledger per repo, and the SCORECARD renders it as a published board where the human prompter and the model are scored side by side.
